links.outcome: Whether analysis of clinician responses to alerts identifies changes to alert criteria and reducible firings
links.effect: 96 helpful suggestions identified; 278,807 firings (9.3%) could have been eliminated; suggestions also revealed workflow and education issues.
links.quote: A total of 278 807 firings (9.3%) could have been eliminated.

unlisted_practices: Using explainable AI on machine learning models predicting user responses to alerts to generate suggestions for refining clinical decision support alert criteria

screen.reason: Evaluates using explainable AI to optimize clinical decision support alert criteria retrospectively and validates suggestions against historical changes and stakeholder feedback.
